tools.name: check_database_health
tools.description: Check database for inconsistencies, orphaned records, and data integrity issues.

tools.name: check_stack_invariants
tools.description: Detect common stack data issues: single-image stacks, images pointing at missing stacks, stacks with no images. Returns counts and small samples.

tools.name: diagnose_phase_consistency
tools.description: Diagnose folder vs per-image phase status mismatch (e.g. folder shows 69/69 KEYWORDS done but image shows Pending).

tools.name: execute_code
tools.description: Execute Python code in the WebUI process with access to gr, demo, and all Gradio components. Requires MCP server **`is-be-webui`** (SSE) and `ENABLE_MCP_EXECUTE_CODE=1`. Globals: gr, demo, components, runner, tagging_runner, orchestrator, db, config.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL SELECT (or WITH … SELECT) query. Uses the same ``?`` placeholder dialect as the app; translated on PostgreSQL. Discover tables/columns with ``get_db_schema`` first.

tools.name: export_debug_bundle
tools.description: Write a redacted support zip (config, environment, doctor JSON, log tails). Same content as ``scripts/export_debug_bundle.py``.

tools.name: find_near_duplicates
tools.description: Detect visually duplicate or near-duplicate images even when file hashes differ. Returns a list of near-duplicate image pairs.
tools.args_summary: (threshold: Optional[float] = None, folder_path: Optional[str] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None)

tools.name: find_outliers
tools.description: Identify visually atypical images in a folder using embedding similarity analysis. Computes top-K mean cosine similarity per image and flags statistical outliers via z-score. Returns flagged images with explainability (nearest neighbors, folder stats).
tools.args_summary: (folder_path: str = '', z_threshold: Optional[float] = None, k: Optional[int] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None)

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Get current application configuration (config.json merged with environment.json). Sensitive keys are redacted.

tools.name: get_database_engine_info
tools.description: Summarize database.engine, connector mode, non-secret connection targets, and whether a simple query succeeds. Complements validate_config.

tools.name: get_database_stats
tools.description: Get comprehensive database statistics including image counts, score distributions, and job summaries.

tools.name: get_db_schema
tools.description: List ``public`` tables and columns (data type, nullability) for writing ``execute_sql`` queries. PostgreSQL only.
tools.args_summary: (table_name_prefix: Optional[str] = None, max_tables: int = 200, max_column_rows: int = 8000)

tools.name: get_drive_diagnostics
tools.description: Auto-drive loop status, folder health, recent auto-drive jobs, and anomaly hints.

tools.name: get_embedding_stats
tools.description: Counts of images with vs without a stored image embedding.

tools.name: get_error_summary
tools.description: Get summary of errors and issues in the database including failed jobs and missing scores.

tools.name: get_failed_images
tools.description: Images missing key quality scores (NULL or <= 0): general, technical, spaq, koniq, ava, paq2piq, liqe.

tools.name: get_folder_tree
tools.description: Get folder tree structure from database with image counts.

tools.name: get_image_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific image by file path.

tools.name: get_image_pipeline_failures
tools.description: Recent ``job_image_actions`` rows with action ``failed`` for one image (by ``image_id`` or ``file_path``).
tools.args_summary: (image_id: Optional[int] = None, file_path: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 50)

tools.name: get_incomplete_images
tools.description: Images with missing composite scores, model scores, rating, or label (broader than get_failed_images).

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Get one job/run by id (jobs.id): status, paths, timestamps, queue_payload summary, log tail. Same id as workflow run_id in the API.

tools.name: get_job_execution_report
tools.description: Structured execution report for a job: what the run did to each image.
examples: what did run do per image
tools.args_summary: (run_id: int, phase_code: Optional[str] = None, action: Optional[str] = None, offset: int = 0, limit: int = 20)

tools.name: get_job_phases
tools.description: List phase rows (order, code, state, timestamps, errors) for a job/run id.

tools.name: get_job_stage_images
tools.description: Paginate per-image phase status for a job+phase (image_phase_status). Optional include_steps adds job_steps telemetry for that phase.
examples: images in scoring phase for job
tools.args_summary: (job_id: int, phase_code: str, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0, include_steps: bool = False)

tools.name: get_location_stats
tools.description: Summarize GPS and geocode coverage in ``image_exif`` (PostgreSQL; requires migration 0013 columns).

tools.name: get_model_status
tools.description: Get status of registered scoring models, GPU availability, and CUDA/PyTorch/TensorFlow configuration.

tools.name: get_newly_imported_folders
tools.description: Find folders created in the last N days with at least min_images.
tools.args_summary: (days: int = 7, min_images: int = 1, path_pattern: Optional[str] = None)

tools.name: get_performance_metrics
tools.description: Get performance metrics from recent jobs: avg job duration, jobs completed/failed, success rate, jobs by status.

tools.name: get_pipeline_stats
tools.description: Get statistics about the processing pipeline and active jobs. Runner status, queue sizes, dispatcher state, and active job info.

tools.name: get_recent_jobs
tools.description: Get recent scoring/tagging jobs with their status.

tools.name: get_run_diagnostics
tools.description: Post-run audit snapshot from queue_payload plus per-phase image_phase_status counts for this job/run id.

tools.name: get_runner_status
tools.description: Get current status of scoring and tagging background runners including progress and recent logs.

tools.name: get_server_log_tail
tools.description: Tail webui.log and/or debug.log (same paths and caps as GET /api/status/log-tails).

tools.name: get_stacks_summary
tools.description: Get summary of image stacks/clusters including size distribution and largest stacks.

tools.name: get_stale_running_phase_status
tools.description: Find image_phase_status rows stuck in ``running`` longer than ``min_age_seconds`` (folder rollup drift).

tools.name: get_system_resources
tools.description: CPU and RAM snapshot plus optional ``nvidia-smi`` GPU rows. Does not require database access.

tools.name: get_thread_dump
tools.description: Capture a full Python thread dump for backend diagnostic and stall debugging.

tools.name: manage_runners
tools.description: Request ``stop`` or read ``status`` for an in-process background runner (WebUI / SSE context). Starting jobs is not supported here — use ``run_processing_job`` or the UI.

tools.name: process_newly_imported_folders
tools.description: Trigger background processing jobs for newly imported folders that haven't been completed yet.
tools.args_summary: (days: int = 7, job_type: str = 'scoring', path_pattern: Optional[str] = None)

tools.name: propagate_tags
tools.description: Propagate keywords from tagged images to untagged neighbors using embedding cosine similarity. Uses weighted voting with configurable thresholds. Defaults to dry_run=true for safe preview.
tools.args_summary: (folder_path: Optional[str] = None, dry_run: bool = True, k: Optional[int] = None, min_similarity: Optional[float] = None, min_keyword_confidence: Optional[float] = None)

tools.name: prune_missing_files
tools.description: Remove database records for images whose files no longer exist on disk.
examples: remove db rows for missing files

tools.name: query_images
tools.description: Query images with flexible filtering and pagination. Supports filtering by score range, rating, label, keywords, and folder.
tools.args_summary: (limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sort_by: str = 'created_at', order: str = 'desc', min_score: Optional[float] = None, max_score: Optional[float] = None, rating: Optional[int] = None, label: Optional[str] = None, keyword: Optional[str] = None, folder_path: Optional[str] = None)

tools.name: read_debug_log
tools.description: Read recent entries from debug.log (JSON lines); falls back to raw line in entries.

tools.name: rebase_file_paths
tools.description: Batch update image file paths by replacing a root prefix.
examples: update paths after drive letter change
tools.args_summary: (old_root: str, new_root: str, dry_run: bool = True)

tools.name: run_processing_job
tools.description: Trigger a background processing job (scoring, tagging, clustering/stacks, or bird_species).
tools.args_summary: (job_type: str, input_path: str, args: dict = None)

tools.name: search_images_by_hash
tools.description: Find an image by content hash (image_hash column, typically SHA-256). Returns file_paths when found.

tools.name: search_images_by_text
tools.description: Search images by free-text query using CLIP text-to-image similarity.
tools.args_summary: (query: str, limit: int = 20, folder_path: Optional[str] = None, folder_ids: Optional[list[int]] = None, min_similarity: Optional[float] = None, min_rating: Optional[int] = None, color_label: Optional[str] = None, keyword: Optional[str] = None, captured_date: Optional[str] = None, sort_by: Optional[str] = None, order: Optional[str] = None)

tools.name: search_logs
tools.description: Search the tail of ``webui.log`` / ``debug.log`` for a regex ``pattern``; returns matching lines with optional context.
tools.args_summary: (pattern: str, sources: str = 'all', context_lines: int = 2, max_lines_scan: int = 25000, max_matches_per_file: int = 40, case_insensitive: bool = True)

tools.name: search_similar_images
tools.description: Find images visually similar to an example image using stored embeddings and cosine similarity.
tools.args_summary: (example_path: Optional[str] = None, example_image_id: Optional[int] = None, limit: int = 20, folder_path: Optional[str] = None, min_similarity: Optional[float] = None, embedding_space: Optional[str] = None)

tools.name: set_config_value
tools.description: Set a configuration value in config.json.

tools.name: set_image_metadata
tools.description: Update metadata for a specific image in the database.
tools.args_summary: (file_path: str, rating: Optional[int] = None, label: Optional[str] = None)

tools.name: validate_config
tools.description: Validate config structure and referenced paths; optionally ping the database when available.

tools.name: validate_file_paths
tools.description: Validate that image ``file_path`` values exist on disk. Optional ``folder_path`` restricts to images under that folder path (exact ``folders.path`` match or descendants). When ``missing_only`` is true, only missing files are listed (scans up to ``limit`` missing rows, expanding the DB fetch window).
tools.args_summary: (limit: int = 100, folder_path: Optional[str] = None, missing_only: bool = False)

tools.name: verify_environment
tools.description: Comprehensive environment check: GPU, DB, Python, and system stats.
